en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a hilly, forested valley with scattered farm fields and villas. A small settlement stretches along a winding road; at the bottom of the image stands a multi‑storey building labeled "Hotel Engelmann" with traditional Alpine-style architecture. Behind it are more houses, a church‑like villa with a small tower, tree‑lined avenues, and wooded hills in the background.
